connect.descPick: Pick a built-in provider and enter its API key, or add a custom OpenAI-compatible service. Once configured, create a new session to start.
connect.descKey: Enter this provider's API key to get started.
connect.descCustom: Any OpenAI-compatible service can be connected here manually.
connect.loadFailed: Unable to read provider config (backend offline?)
connect.ctxPositive: Context window must be a positive integer
connect.maxPositive: Max output tokens must be a positive integer
connect.maxExceedsCtx: Max output tokens cannot exceed the context window (use the real limits from the official API docs)
connect.name: Provider name
connect.formHint: Use the real values from the provider's official API docs: the context window determines Tianshu's auto-compaction point (too small compacts too early and loses context; too large hits the API limit); max output is the per-reply cap and cannot exceed the context window. DeepSeek V4 reference: context 1000000, max output 384000.

firstRunStorage.title: Choose a data storage location
firstRunStorage.desc: First launch requires choosing the Tianshu data directory; you can change it later under Settings → System → Storage location.

firstRunGit.title: Git installation required
firstRunGit.desc: On Windows, Tianshu prefers Git's bundled Git Bash to run commands (build, test, git, etc.). Git was not detected, so command execution falls back to PowerShell/cmd and some commands may misbehave or produce no output. Install Git for Windows, then re-check.
firstRunGit.step1: Click "Open download page" to get the Git for Windows installer.
firstRunGit.step2: Keep the default options during installation (make sure "Git from the command line" is checked).
firstRunGit.hint: Installed in a non-default location? Enter the full path to bash.exe under Settings › System › Command execution shell (no environment variable changes needed).

templates.title: Project bootstrap files
templates.desc: This project is missing AGENTS.md and .rivet.md. These two documents tell Tianshu how to work in this project: coding standards, safety discipline, tech stack, testing conventions, and more.
templates.agentsDesc: Agent behavior discipline, safety boundaries, project-specific rules.
templates.rivetDesc: Project metadata: tech stack, build commands, test commands.
templates.editNote: After creating them you can edit both files in the project directory; Tianshu reads them at the start of every session.
